messages:
Emily (PM): Kicking off staged rollout to 10% in eu-west during tonight's change window (23:00-01:00 UTC). Pinned image: v2.3.1-canary. Deploybot will shift traffic in batches. Please watch latency, error-rate, and kv cache OOMs. @sanjay you're infra lead for this chunk.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollout: service=redwood-infer, version=v2.3.1-canary, target=10%, region=eu-west. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/1767891234
sanjay: On it. I’ll keep an eye on p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate and node memory. Alert channel set to #eng-oncall if anything crosses thresholds.
alice: Quick note — CI flagged a minor input validation change in v2.3.1 but it passed canary tests. Not expecting functional regressions, but watch for small formatting diffs in prompts.
nate: Seeing a small p99 bump on a subset of pods after shift: +220ms around 23:02. 5xx steady at 0.2% (baseline 0.05%). Link to screenshot: https://metrics.redwood.internal/shot/abc123
ops-oncall: Noted. I'm toggling extended tracing on the canary set to capture slow tails.
alice: That p99 bump looks like KV cache cold misses on those pods. Could be cache warming. If it doesn't recover within 5–10m we should consider holding.
sanjay: Can we hold at 10% for 15m while cache warms? I can increase read-ahead/cache prefill on the canary nodes.
emily (PM): Proposal: Hold at 10% for 15m. If p99 > +150ms sustained or 5xx > 0.5% we roll back to v2.3.0. All in favor react with :thumbsup: within 2m.
alice: +1
sanjay: +1
nate: +1
deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 10% complete. Canary pods: 6/6 healthy. (rollout id 1767891234)
ops-oncall: Added runbook link and rollback playbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/rollback-v2
emily (PM): OK holding. Sanjay, please post an update at +5m and +15m. If metrics look stable at +15m we do a gradual increase to 30% and call out any ACQ for downstream teams.
5m_check — sanjay: p50/p95 stable, p99 trending down to +90ms. 5xx at 0.18%. Cache prefill completed on two nodes.
10m_check — nate: p99 back within +50ms of baseline. No spike in customer errors. Tracing points to cold-start misses resolved.
15m_check — sanjay: All green. p99 within acceptable delta, 5xx < 0.2%. Recommending advance to 30% after a 5m cool-off. Any objections?
alice: No objections from product side. Will update release notes with observed formatting diffs and mitigation steps.
emily (PM): Cool-off then advance. Deploy-bot, schedule the 30% shift with a 2m ramp and notify this channel when done.
deploy-bot: Scheduled incremental shift: to 30% over 2 minutes. Will post when complete.
Shortly after — deploy-bot: Shift complete. Canary now at 30%. Monitoring.
ops-oncall: Monitoring fine so far; keeping traces on for another 30m. If any service crosses thresholds we revert using rollback playbook.
emily (PM): Thanks all. Leaving this thread open for final bake. If anyone sees a regression after the increase, call the rollback and ping @ops-oncall immediately.
